cards.title: Loyalty isn't just about the discount
cards.body: Hopping between chemists for a few rupees off feels smart. Sticking with one has quieter benefits.

cards.title: They see the full list
cards.body: One chemist sees all your parent's medicines, from every doctor. That makes duplicates and clashes easier to spot.

cards.title: They notice changes
cards.body: A new strength, a new brand, a medicine that suddenly stopped. A regular chemist asks about it.

cards.title: Refills don't run dry
cards.body: They know when Papa usually comes in, and can keep his regular medicines in stock.

cards.title: Faster help in a pinch
cards.body: Need a quick answer about a missed dose or a side effect? Calling someone who already knows you is easier.

cards.title: Easier for the whole family
cards.body: Any sibling can walk in, say "Papa ki dawai", and the chemist knows exactly what's going on.

cards.title: One counter, fewer mix-ups
cards.body: Find a chemist you trust and stay. The relationship is the real discount.

takeaway: One regular chemist sees all your medicines, spots changes, keeps refills ready and helps faster when you need it.
share: Send this to the family that switches chemists for every small discount.
